devices.name: SW-CORE-01
devices.config:
version 15.0
service timestamps debug datetime msec
no service password-encryption
!
hostname SW-CORE-01
!
enable password cisco123
!
username admin password 0 admin123
!
interface Vlan1
 ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan all
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 1
!
ip default-gateway 192.168.1.254
!
no ip ssh version 2
line vty 0 4
 transport input telnet
 password cisco
!
snmp-server community public RO
snmp-server community private RW
!
end

devices.name: RTR-EDGE-02
devices.config:
version 16.9
service timestamps debug datetime msec
service password-encryption
!
hostname RTR-EDGE-02
!
enable secret 5 $1$mERr$9cTjUIkjHVrzdV5pzqMpX1
!
username netadmin privilege 15 secret 5 $1$mERr$hashedpassword123
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 description WAN-UPLINK
 ip address 203.0.113.10 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 description LAN-CORE
 ip address 10.0.0.254 255.255.0.0
 no shutdown
!
ip ssh version 2
ip ssh time-out 60
ip ssh authentication-retries 3
!
line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
!
no snmp-server
!
end

devices.name: SW-ACCESS-03
devices.config:
version 12.2
no service password-encryption
!
hostname SW-ACCESS-03
!
enable password letmein
!
interface Vlan1
 ip address 172.16.300.5 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
interface FastEthernet0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 1
!
interface FastEthernet0/2
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 1
!
ip default-gateway 172.16.300.1
!
line vty 0 4
 transport input telnet
 no password
!
end
